//: Vercel Build Output API config, copied to .vercel/output/config.json by
.github/workflows/web.yml. It lives here rather than being written inline
in the workflow so the caching and routing rules are reviewable in a diff.
Not a vercel.json: the workflow builds with `npm run build` rather than
`vercel build`, because the build needs VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE from the git
tag and the source maps have to be uploaded and then deleted before the
output is deployed. This is the deterministic version of that.

routes.//: Content-hashed by Vite, so the name changes whenever the bytes do.
Never cache the worker script or the shell. A stale sw.js pins a broken deploy in place for as long as it is cached, which is exactly when it hurts most.
Route geometry and the stop index: ~5MB, not content-hashed, and changed by TfL a few times a year. Same policy the backend serves /routes under, so the two agree.
Single page app: anything not on disk is the shell.
